grammar.pattern: 量词重叠：个个 / 本本 / 张张等
grammar.purpose: Read distribution within a stated set
grammar.explanation: 这六张纸张张都有名字 means each of these six sheets bears a name; it does not prove every sheet anywhere is named. 本本都读过 ranges over the books just mentioned. Not every classifier repeats equally naturally in all contexts; use 个个/本本/张张 with a clear noun or preceding set. Compare 每张 rather than invent a new total from repetition.

examples.zh: 这六张纸，张张都有名字。
examples.py: zhè liù zhāng zhǐ , zhāng zhāng dōu yǒu míng zì .
examples.en: Each of these six sheets bears a name.

examples.py: zhè xiē shū , běn běn dōu dú guò .
examples.en: Each of these books has been read.

examples.zh: 组里的朋友个个都来了。
examples.py: zǔ lǐ de péng you gè gè dōu lái le .
examples.en: Every friend in the group came.

commonMistakes.wrong: 张张有名字，所以世界上所有纸都有名字。
commonMistakes.right: 这六张纸张张有名字，只说这六张。
commonMistakes.why: The distributive scope remains the stated set.

grammar.pattern: 数词 + 量词重复：一个一个 / 一张一张
grammar.purpose: Read sequential handling and context-dependent distribution
grammar.explanation: 一张一张递 describes passing sheets one at a time. 两张两张发 distributes or handles two at a time; with six sheets this means three batches, not two total sheets. 一人一张 states individual allocation and has a different pattern. Repetition alone does not establish the overall quantity or completion.

examples.zh: 把六张纸一张一张递过来。
examples.py: bǎ liù zhāng zhǐ yī zhāng yī zhāng dì guò lái .
examples.en: Pass the six sheets over one at a time.

examples.py: liǎng zhāng liǎng zhāng fā , yī gòng liù zhāng .
examples.en: Distribute them two at a time, six in total.

examples.zh: 一人一张，六个人要六张。
examples.py: yī rén yī zhāng , liù gè rén yào liù zhāng .
examples.en: One sheet per person: six people need six sheets.

commonMistakes.wrong: 两张两张发，所以一共只有两张。
commonMistakes.right: 两张两张发是方式，总数还要看说明。
commonMistakes.why: Batch size is not total quantity.

lines.speaker: a

lines.py: zhǐ yǒu sì zhāng , hái quē liǎng zhāng .

lines.speaker: b

lines.en: I'll fetch them. You lay out the pens.
lines.speaker: a

lines.py: xíng , gěi měi zǔ pèi liǎng zhī bǐ ?
lines.en: Okay. Two pens per group?
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: duì . liǎng zǔ fēn bié ná sān zhāng zhǐ .
lines.en: Yes. Three sheets for each of the two groups.
lines.speaker: a

lines.py: zhǐ shàng yào xiě míng zi ma ?

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 写吧，大家一张一张递给我。
lines.py: xiě ba , dà jiā yī zhāng yī zhāng dì gěi wǒ .

lines.speaker: a

lines.py: hǎo . zhè gè huó dòng shōu fèi ma ?
lines.en: Okay. Is there a charge for this activity?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不收费，大家来坐坐，聊聊书就行。
lines.py: bù shōu fèi , dà jiā lái zuò zuò , liáo liáo shū jiù xíng .

lines.speaker: a

lines.py: nà wǒ zài jiào yī gè péng you lái ?

lines.zh: 可以，不过我得再拿一张纸。

reading.title: An allocation note
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 读书小组今天有六个人，我到得早，先帮忙放纸和笔。桌上只有四张纸，我又拿来两张，分成两组，每组放三张。
lines.py: dú shū xiǎo zǔ jīn tiān yǒu liù gè rén , wǒ dào de zǎo , xiān bāng máng fàng zhǐ hé bǐ . zhuō shàng zhǐ yǒu sì zhāng zhǐ , wǒ yòu ná lái liǎng zhāng , fēn chéng liǎng zǔ , měi zǔ fàng sān zhāng .
lines.en: Six people came to today's reading group. I arrived early to help with paper and pens. There were four sheets; I fetched two more and put three on each group's table.

lines.zh: 林安问笔怎么配，我说每组两支，大家轮着用。她把椅子也放好，门口很快就有人进来了。
lines.py: lín ān wèn bǐ zěn me pèi , wǒ shuō měi zǔ liǎng zhī , dà jiā lún zhe yòng . tā bǎ yǐ zi yě fàng hǎo , mén kǒu hěn kuài jiù yǒu rén jìn lái le .
lines.en: Lin An asked about pens. Each group could share two. She arranged the chairs too, and people soon began arriving.

lines.zh: 有人第一次来，问活动是不是收费。我说不收费，只要带一本自己想说的书。她笑了，说这次带了两本，正好可以借给别人。
lines.py: yǒu rén dì yī cì lái , wèn huó dòng shì bú shì shōu fèi . wǒ shuō bù shōu fèi , zhǐ yào dài yī běn zì jǐ xiǎng shuō de shū . tā xiào le , shuō zhè cì dài le liǎng běn , zhèng hǎo kě yǐ jiè gěi bié ren .
lines.en: A new visitor asked about the charge. There was none; people just needed a book they wanted to talk about. She smiled: she'd brought two and could lend one.

lines.zh: 六个人到齐以后，大家在纸上写名字，再一张一张递过来。我看见两个相同的姓，就问他们是不是已经认识。
lines.py: liù gè rén dào qí yǐ hòu , dà jiā zài zhǐ shàng xiě míng zi , zài yī zhāng yī zhāng dì guò lái . wǒ kàn jiàn liǎng gè xiāng tóng de xìng , jiù wèn tā men shì bú shì yǐ jīng rèn shi .
lines.en: Once all six had arrived, everyone wrote their name and passed over their sheet. Two shared a surname, so I asked if they knew each other already.

lines.zh: 他们以前没见过，今天却带了同一本书。两个人马上坐到一起，说好一人先讲一段，另一人再接着讲。
lines.py: tā men yǐ qián méi jiàn guò , jīn tiān què dài le tóng yī běn shū . liǎng gè rén mǎ shàng zuò dào yì qǐ , shuō hǎo yī rén xiān jiǎng yī duàn , lìng yī rén zài jiē zhe jiǎng .
lines.en: They hadn't met, but had brought the same book. They sat together immediately and agreed to take turns talking about a passage.

lines.zh: 活动结束时，桌上六张纸都还在，有一支笔却不知道是谁的。我刚问完，大家都笑了，那是我自己带来的。
lines.py: huó dòng jié shù shí , zhuō shàng liù zhāng zhǐ dōu hái zài , yǒu yī zhī bǐ què bù zhī dào shì shéi de . wǒ gāng wèn wán , dà jiā dōu xiào le , nà shì wǒ zì jǐ dài lái de .
lines.en: At the end all six sheets were still on the table, but we couldn't identify one pen. Everyone laughed when I asked: I'd brought it myself.

lines.py: wǒ men fēn bié gěi péng you dǎ le diàn huà .
lines.en: We each called our friends.

lines.zh: 两组分别坐在左边和右边。
lines.py: liǎng zǔ fēn bié zuò zài zuǒ biān hé yòu biān .
lines.en: The two groups sit on the left and right respectively.

lines.py: nǐ xǐ huān nǎ zhǒng xué xí fāng shì ?
lines.en: What way of learning do you prefer?

lines.py: wǒ men huàn yī zhǒng fāng shì shì shì .
lines.en: Let's try a different way.

lines.zh: 我给新眼镜配了一个盒子。
lines.py: wǒ gěi xīn yǎn jìng pèi le yī gè hé zi .
lines.en: I got a case for my new glasses.

lines.py: měi gè fáng jiān pèi liǎng bǎ yǐ zi .
lines.en: Each room gets two chairs.

lines.py: xiè xiè nǐ de pèi hé .
lines.en: Thanks for cooperating.

lines.zh: 你拿着这一边，我来配合你。
lines.py: nǐ ná zhe zhè yī biān , wǒ lái pèi hé nǐ .
lines.en: Hold this side and I'll work with you.

lines.py: rén dào qí le , wǒ men chū fā ba .
lines.en: Everyone's here. Let's set off.

lines.py: zhè xiē bēi zi fàng qí yī diǎn ba .
lines.en: Arrange these cups more evenly.

lines.zh: 我花了整整一天整理房间。
lines.py: wǒ huā le zhěng zhěng yī tiān zhěng lǐ fáng jiān .
lines.en: I spent a whole day tidying the room.

lines.zh: 这本书我看了整整三遍。
lines.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le zhěng zhěng sān biàn .
lines.en: I read this book three full times.

lines.zh: 整个房间都是花的香味。
lines.py: zhěng gè fáng jiān dōu shì huā de xiāng wèi .
lines.en: The whole room smells of flowers.

lines.py: zhěng gè xiǎo zǔ dōu lái le .
lines.en: The entire group came.

lines.py: cóng zhěng tǐ kàn , fáng jiān hěn shū fú .
lines.en: Overall, the room feels comfortable.

lines.zh: 这个计划的整体安排不错。
lines.py: zhè gè jì huà de zhěng tǐ ān pái bù cuò .
lines.en: The overall arrangement of this plan is good.

lines.zh: 她全面介绍了活动的安排。
lines.py: tā quán miàn jiè shào le huó dòng de ān pái .
lines.en: She gave a comprehensive introduction to the event arrangements.

lines.zh: 我们想更全面地了解这座城市。
lines.py: wǒ men xiǎng gèng quán miàn de liǎo jiě zhè zuò chéng shì .
lines.en: We'd like to understand this city more fully.

lines.py: wǒ zài rén qún lǐ zhǎo dào le tā .
lines.en: I found her in the crowd.

lines.py: rén qún màn màn zǒu chū le chē zhàn .
lines.en: The crowd slowly left the station.

lines.zh: 双方约好了见面的时间。
lines.py: shuāng fāng yuē hǎo le jiàn miàn de shí jiān .
lines.en: Both sides agreed on a meeting time.

lines.py: shuāng fāng dōu yuàn yì zài tán yī cì .
lines.en: Both sides are willing to talk again.

lines.py: zhè běn shū èr shí yuán rén mín bì .
lines.en: This book costs twenty renminbi.

lines.py: nǐ zhè lǐ néng yòng rén mín bì ma ?
lines.en: Can I use renminbi here?

lines.py: zhè dùn fàn wǒ lái fù qián .
lines.en: I'll pay for this meal.

lines.py: qián fù wán le , wǒ men zǒu ba .
lines.en: We've paid. Let's go.

lines.py: kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī zhī fù .
lines.en: You can pay by phone.

lines.zh: 支付完成以后，我收到了消息。
lines.py: zhī fù wán chéng yǐ hòu , wǒ shōu dào le xiāo xī .
lines.en: I got a message when the payment was complete.

lines.py: jīn tiān xià wǔ qù jiāo fèi .
lines.en: I'll go and pay the fee this afternoon.

lines.py: bào míng yǐ hòu , hái yào jiāo fèi ma ?
lines.en: Is there a fee after signing up?

lines.py: zhè gè huó dòng bù shōu fèi .
lines.en: There's no charge for this event.

lines.py: zhè lǐ tíng chē zěn me shōu fèi ?
lines.en: How much do you charge for parking here?
